appName.message: Merid: Học tiếng Anh ngay khi lướt web tiếng Việt

appDesc.message: Learn English while you browse: swaps Vietnamese or English words for SAT/CEFR vocabulary, with hover learning cards.

aiModalTitle.message: Get the most out of Merid ✨

aiModalSub.message: Turn on AI Context Check and Merid checks that every swapped word fits its sentence. Words that do not fit change back on their own. All you need is your own free Gemini API key, pasted once:

aiModalStep1.message: Open aistudio.google.com/apikey and sign in with Google.

aiModalStep2.message: Click Create API key, then copy the key (it starts with "AIza…").

aiModalStep3.message: In Merid Settings → AI context check, paste the key and press Save key.

optTagline.message: Passive English vocabulary learning while you browse Vietnamese websites. Works out of the box with no account - sign-in and AI checks are optional extras.

optDirVieEngSub.message: Replace Vietnamese words with the English equivalent

optDirEngEngSub.message: Swap easy English words for harder synonyms

optAllowedNone.message: You have not turned any of these back on.

optAlwaysOffHint.message: Merid never changes words on private pages, and never sends anything from them for the AI context check. This part is not a setting.

optMatchingHint.message: Matching is by site name, so a service that shares a site with something else — Facebook, Instagram and X put messages on the same address as the feed — is not on this list. Neither is anything self-hosted, like a work webmail on a company address. Turn those off yourself above.

optAccountHint.message: Sign in to back up your deck and study it on merid.site/my-deck. Optional - everything keeps working locally without an account.

optLinkWaitHint.message: Link sent ✓ Open the email from Merid, copy the sign-in link address (right-click the button → Copy link), and paste it here to finish:

optOrPassword.message: Or sign in with your password:

optAiHint.message: After Merid replaces a word, Google Gemini checks that it really fits the sentence it landed in. Words that do not fit are swapped for a better one, or changed back on their own. Included - no API key needed. There is a daily limit per person so the service stays available to everyone; signing in raises it.

optAiOwnKeyHint.message: Prefer your own key? Paste a free key from aistudio.google.com and Merid will use it instead - requests go straight from this browser to Google, with no daily limit from us. Step-by-step guide ↗

optProfileTitle.message: What Merid has learned about you

optProfileHint.message:
Merid watches which words you save, rate and skip, and quietly shows more of what
                suits you and less of what does not. It all stays on this device (and in your own account if
                you sign in). Nothing here is sent to Merid.

optProfileEmpty.message:
Nothing yet. Hover a highlighted word and use 👍 / 👎, "Save to Deck"
                or "I know this" a few times, and this fills in.

optPrivacy1.message: Page text is scanned locally in your browser to find vocabulary matches.

optPrivacy2.message: By default the extension makes no network requests - page content stays in your browser and no AI API is used until you opt in below.

optPrivacy3.message: With the AI context check on, short pieces of the sentence around each replaced word are sent to Google Gemini - by default through merid.site/api/check, which calls Gemini with Merid's keys and keeps only a per-day counter so the daily limit can be enforced. No page addresses, titles or browsing history are sent. Turn the check off above and nothing is sent at all. If you save your own API key, requests go straight from this browser to Google instead and never reach a Merid server.

optPrivacy4.message: To count the daily limit without requiring an account, Merid creates an anonymous Firebase account for this device on first use. It holds no personal information. Signing in replaces it and raises the limit.

optPrivacy5.message: If you sign in to the optional deck sync, your email address and your deck (saved words + known words) are stored in your own Merid account (Google Firebase) so you can study on merid.site. Signing out stops all syncing.

optPrivacy6.message: Merid keeps a personalization profile on this device: counts of how often each word was shown, opened, rated, saved or skipped, plus the word's level and a coarse subject area from the page address. It holds no page text, no titles, no full URLs and no browsing history. If you sign in it is backed up to your own account so your preferences follow you. Read it back - and erase it on its own - under What Merid has learned about you above.

optPrivacy7.message: Merid never runs at all on private pages - email, messaging, banking, sign-in, health and official services - so nothing from them is ever scanned or sent, whatever the AI check is set to. See Sites above for the full list.

optPrivacy8.message: Your settings (selected dataset, display mode, intensity, on/off, the sites you turned off and the default-off sites you turned back on) are stored on your device via chrome.storage.

optPrivacy9.message: Custom vocabulary datasets you upload are validated and stored only on this device - they are never uploaded to Merid, Firebase, or any AI service, and are not part of deck sync.

optPrivacy10.message: Turn the extension off any time from the popup - globally, or just for one site.
